vot_greeter: Hey, you're awake. I'm Nakhtar. This is the Valley of Trials, where the Horde trains new recruits. I've got some jobs for you when you're ready.
vot_guard_1: If you're looking for something to fight, there's plenty. Boars to the west, scorpids to the north-east, and a cave full of demons past the scorpids.
vot_elder: I'm Kuraw, I help train the recruits. If you want to learn how caves work, come and talk to me.
vot_recruit_watcher: Watch yourself on Sagebrush Flat. Most of the boars are fine, but there's one massive one out there that keeps knocking over the training dummies.
vot_goblin_tinkerer: Hi! I'm Fizzcrank, I'm doing a bit of research. Please don't touch the bench, I think part of it's on fire.
vot_orc_mother: My son's one of the recruits here. If you're going into the Den, come and see me first, I could use a hand.
vot_wounded_grunt: A scorpid got my leg. Nakhtar says I'll walk again soon, but for now I'm stuck sitting here.
vot_skeleton_curiosity: [A skeleton, upright, at the edge of camp. It does not move and it does not speak. Nobody here put it there, and nobody has been willing to be the one who takes it down.]
vot_young_orc: I've killed more boars than anyone my age here. I want something better than a boar before I leave, though.
ct_vot: Come and see me when you've gained a level and I'll teach you something new. It costs a bit of coin.
pt_vot_forge: I can teach you mining. The forge is just north of here if you want to smelt anything. For smithing you'll need to go to Razor Hill.
pt_vot_herbs: I can teach you herbalism. If you want to learn to brew things, Kagra teaches alchemy in Razor Hill.
pt_vot_wood: I can teach you woodcutting. The sawmill's just north-west of here, past Marta's fire. Hulda teaches woodworking in Razor Hill if you want to build things.
